papers.title: Laser Directed Energy Deposition of Inconel625 to Ti6Al4V Heterostructure via Nonlinear Gradient Transition Interlayers
papers.abstract: Heterostructure (HS) refers to a class of structural materials composed of two or more different chemical components or crystal structures. Integration of Inconel 625 (IN625) nickel-based superalloy and Ti6Al4V (TC4) titanium alloy to a HS material offers a promising strategy to achieve graded thermo-mechanical properties, extended service temperature ranges, and significant weight reduction, which are highly desirable in aerospace applications. However, obtaining a better metallurgical bonding between the two alloys remains a critical challenge. In this study, laser directed energy deposition (L-DED) technology was employed to fabricate IN625/TC4 HS materials with a nonlinear gradient transition, following systematic investigations into the phase composition and crack sensitivity of IN625/TC4 gradient layers prepared from mixed powders of varying compositions. In addition, microstructure, phase distribution, and mechanical properties of HS materials at room temperature were characterized. The metallurgical defect-free IN625/TC4 HS material was successfully prepared, featuring a smooth transition of microstructure, reduced cracking sensitivity, and reliable metallurgical bonding. Furthermore, a novel design concept and illustrative reference for the L-DED fabrication of N625/TC4 HS material with excellent comprehensive performance was presented, while providing a theoretical metallurgical basis and data support for the potential applications of IN625/TC4 HS materials in the field of aerospace.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究Inconel625与Ti6Al4V异种材料的梯度过渡连接，而非Ti6Al4V本身的力学或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: Paper focuses on bonding of dissimilar alloys (IN625 to TC4) via gradient interlayers, not on mechanical/fatigue characterization of Ti-6Al-4V itself.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现Inconel625与Ti6Al4V异种合金的无缺陷冶金结合
summary_zh.method: 采用激光定向能量沉积技术制备非线性梯度过渡层
summary_zh.result: 成功制备出微观组织平滑过渡、裂纹敏感性降低的可靠结合异质结构
summary_zh.validation: 通过室温力学性能测试和显微组织表征验证

summary_en.motivation: To achieve defect-free metallurgical bonding between Inconel625 and Ti6Al4V for graded thermo-mechanical properties in aerospace applications.
summary_en.method: Laser directed energy deposition (L-DED) was used to fabricate IN625/TC4 heterostructures with a nonlinear compositional gradient via mixed powder layers.
summary_en.result: A defect-free heterostructure with smooth microstructure transition, reduced cracking sensitivity, and reliable metallurgical bonding was obtained.
summary_en.validation: Room-temperature mechanical testing and microstructural characterization confirmed the integrity and performance of the heterostructure.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究真空电弧熔炼制备的复合材料，并非增材制造，与用户关注方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not use additive manufacturing (LPBF/SLM/EBM/DED) but vacuum arc melting, and focuses on tribological properties rather than mechanical or fatigue characterization required for this direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究石墨烯对FLG/SiC/TC4复合材料微观结构和摩擦性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用真空电弧熔炼制备复合材料，并进行微观结构和摩擦学性能测试。
summary_zh.result: 石墨烯的添加改善了复合材料的摩擦学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过摩擦磨损试验验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of graphene on the microstructure and tribological properties of FLG/SiC/TC4 composites.
summary_en.method: Composites were fabricated by vacuum arc melting and characterized for microstructure and tribological performance.
summary_en.result: Addition of graphene improved the tribological properties of the composites.
summary_en.validation: Tribological tests were conducted to validate the performance.
